import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    arr = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    t = int(next(it))
    arr.sort()
    max_count = 0
    for left in range(n):
        count = 0
        remaining = t
        for right in range(left, n):
            if right > left:
                remaining -= arr[right] - arr[right - 1]
                if remaining < 0:
                    break
            count += 1
        if count > max_count:
            max_count = count
    print(max_count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
